notes.subject: परान
notes.rationale: נפש here is the psalmist's living self, the breath-life; 'परान' keeps the life-force sense, not an immortal-soul reading.

notes.subject: to the psalmist's own soul
notes.rationale: Feminine singular imperative ברכי addressed to the speaker's own נפש, reframing the verse from cosmos to self.

notes.subject: ברכו…ברכי
notes.rationale: Masculine plural and feminine singular imperatives of the same verb bracket the verse; the Magahi renders both as 'असीस दे', losing the gender echo.

notes.subject: to all YHWH's works
notes.rationale: The call widens to all creation in every place of His dominion, then turns inward — psalm's closing inclusio with verse 1.

translation: यहवे के असीस देवऽ हइ ओकर सब काम, ओकर राज के हर जगह; असीस दे, हमरा परान, यहवे ⟨את⟩ के।
